title: DNS rebinding SSRF caveat buried in comment
description: src/federation.rs:60-63. The comment at line 60 documents that DNS rebinding is NOT mitigated. This is an important security limitation — an attacker's domain can resolve to a public IP during validate_outbound_url() but re-resolve to a private IP during the actual reqwest connection. The comment is correct but should be elevated: a tracing::warn on startup or in the Config validation would make this visible in operator logs rather than only to source readers.
